verdict.rationale: Carta has a documented public REST API platform with OAuth 2.0 authorization, developer portal, playground/sandbox, extensive reference docs covering cap tables, stakeholders, option grants, valuations, and even Postman guides, clearly enabling programmatic/AI-native access. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt was found (probes returned 404s), which would strengthen machine-readability claims.
